statements.statement: The procedure code billed was CPT 93229
The denial reason code was CO-197
The patient has recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other unspecified cardiac arrhythmias
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
Continuous mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to detect intermittent rhythm disturbances
The service was ordered to guide appropriate anticoagulation and rate control management
